acquire_timeout|Failed to acquire lock for .* after

U1.title: clean update
U1.declaredRed: any non-zero exit or timeout of the update step, or a violated common condition

U2.title: update killed at activation record creation, reinstall, update
U2.declaredRed: the documented reinstall refuses (e.g. installer_lock_refused), or target_changed / activation_requires_reconciliation / any failure of the final update

U3.title: update while a gjc process (sdk broker) runs from the install
U3.declaredRed: publish failure or a violated common condition after the holder exits

U4.title: update killed at activation record creation, update again without reinstall
U4.declaredRed: the stale record permanently blocks update (reconciliation error)

L1.title: 10 concurrent `gjc config set` x 20 rounds (file-lock via atomic-yaml-patch)
L1.declaredRed: access_denied, operation_failed, any other failure, or a crash log

L2.title: 10 concurrent `gjc state ralplan write` x 20 rounds on one session
L2.declaredRed: any failed write, an unparsable state file, or a crash log

L3.title: legacy host-unqualified broker.lock from real v0.18.11, then `gjc sdk session list`
L3.declaredRed: operation_failed, any other failure, or a crash log

L4.title: `gjc gc --prune` concurrent with 10x `gjc config set` x 10 rounds
L4.declaredRed: any other failure or a crash log

I1.title: installer killed after its download temp appears, then re-run
I1.declaredRed: the re-run refuses (installer_lock_refused): the user must remove the lock by hand

I2.title: installer replaces gjc.exe while a gjc process runs from it (PS 5.1 and 7)
I2.declaredRed: publish failure (publish_target_exists, sharing_violation) or a lost binary

I3.title: two installers started concurrently
I3.declaredRed: both fail, or a lock is left behind
